messages:
maria: Quick sync — proposing an "ownership cartography" spike to map hotpaths + tech-debt candidates across the runtime. Goal: 3 weeks, 2 engineers, deliverable = extract plan + risk matrix. Thoughts?

jamal: +1 for mapping. Can we scope it to modules that touch per-request latency + KV cache?

maria: yep. initial scope: request-router, kv-cache, session-controller, batcher, model-adapter. Keep enrichment and billing out for this run.

ben: how do we measure "debt impact"? need concrete signals so we don't just gut things that are stable.

sophia: suggest metrics: p50/p95 latency delta when we stub a module, error surface, and token-cost delta. Also call volume and change-frequency.

jamal: also capture dependency fan-out (how many services call it). high fan-out = higher coord cost.

maria: agreed. Proposed deliverables: 1) ownership map (graph + ownership suggestion) 2) risk matrix (latency, SLO hit risk, deploy complexity) 3) cut plan for top 2 candidates.

dave: what's the fallback/rollback story if a cut causes regression? can we reserve a canary lane and policy for automatic fallback?

maria: yes — rollout plan includes canary + automatic fallback to previous model variant or host-tier. We'll document runbook steps.

sophia: for the heatmap, we can reuse the flamegraph exporter and add a small probe to capture per-call CPU + mem. jamal/ben — can you own the exporter patch?

jamal: I can take the exporter change. estimate: 2 days to land + 1 day onboarding for spike.

ben: I'll help with the cost/latency regression harness — put together a simple harness that replays sampled requests and compares token counts + latencies.

maria: nice. Also want a naming convention for artifacts so the audit + rollout scripts understand variants. Proposal: `carto/<module>/<candidate>-v<YYYYMMDD>-<author>`

sophia: fine. please include `risk=<low|med|high>` tag in artifact metadata.

maria: example artifact metadata (putting here so we don't forget):
```
module: request-router
candidate: thin-proxy
version: 20260301-maria
risk: med
owner: jamal
metrics: p50,p95,error-rate,fanout
```

jamal: pinging @dave for release coordination and @ben for harness infra when we have artifacts.

infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-1429 "ownership cartography spike: exporter + harness" and assigned to jamal,ben.

maria: meeting to start spike Monday 10am — 30m sync. Agenda: finalize scope, define measurement hooks, initial owners.

dave: put me on the calendar as optional. I'll prioritize canary lane config after the first week.

sophia: action items recap: jamal = exporter + ownership map sketches; ben = harness + cost regressions; maria = risk matrix template + cut plan draft.

maria: perfect. I'll drop a short doc in the architecture folder and the sprint ticket with acceptance criteria. :thumbsup:
